title: Anna Karenina Strikes Again: Pre-Trained LLM Embeddings May Favor High-Performing Learners

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the discoverability of human-graded Knowledge Profiles (KPs) using unsupervised clustering (KMeans and HDBSCAN) on pre-trained LLM embeddings of student responses, and measuring the cosine similarity density of embeddings to show that correct (high-performing) responses are clustered more densely than incorrect ones.
